title: CoderResultPayload
description: Canonical schema for the Coding Agent (Persona 2) structured result emitted via the omp task/yield contract — TDD lifecycle status, touched files, verification evidence, and per-subtask completion ledger from the ExecutionPlanPayload DAG

status.description: TDD lifecycle stage reached by the coder: RED = tests scaffolded and confirmed failing; GREEN = minimal implementation satisfies tests; VERIFIED = full verification commands pass with zero errors/race warnings; BLOCKED = cannot proceed, see blockers

files_created.description: New files written this run (relative paths from workspace root)

files_modified.description: Existing files edited this run (relative paths from workspace root)

tests_passing.description: True when the designated verification commands exit 0 with zero race warnings

verification_output.description: Tail of the final test run output as evidence

blockers.description: Description of blocking issues when status is BLOCKED

subtask_results.description: Per-subtask completion ledger mirroring the ExecutionPlanPayload DAG (docs/architecture/schemas/execution_plan.schema.json)
